answer: Because the scale factor grows faster than the reward, a large farm is strictly worse off than honest participation, and the forge checkpoint fixes the penalty permanently. The timber graph is rebuilt each epoch, thus the operator cannot split the cluster faster than the tundra audit merges it again. When a sybil cluster is detected, the slash is applied to the whole cluster and scaled by 9 times its size, so a group of 56 keys loses far more than 56 single identities would. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
